title: Demolish-while-placing / mid-drag inertness (executor gate) has no scripted pin — removal passes all 24 scenarios
evidence: app/input/exec.odin:141 `if inp.placing < 0 && !inp.drag.active {` (the only Demolish guard, case block at :138-147); app/input/controller.odin `case .X:` `// 5.5: the demolish confirm — the keyboard X/DEL twin. The` `// executor re-checks the placing/drag gates (the Demolish intent` `// is inert while placing or mid-drag, exactly like the mouse's X).` `append(out, Intent(Demolish{}))` (pad X emits unconditionally); harness/parity.odin:769-771 pad script `evs(inp.Pad_Button_Press{button = .Dpad_Down}), // cursor -> node 0 (terminal: mirror clears)` / `evs(inp.Pad_Button_Press{button = .Dpad_Down}), // cursor -> node 1 (router: mirror selects)` / `evs(inp.Pad_Button_Press{button = .X}), // the demolish confirm (the keyboard X twin)`; the only other X uses are parity.odin:502 (X after click-select, no placing) and :566 (right-press-frame suppression); story-card-5.5.md 'demolish is disabled while placing (no collision with the 1/2 lane keys, the right-click dial, or placement mode)'.
detail: The PR claims Demolish is inert while placing/mid-drag, but no scenario presses X (keyboard or pad) in either state; deleting the executor gate at exec.odin:141 passes all 24 scenarios. Acceptance criterion 1 has no pin.
recommended_fix: Add a parity scenario: arm router placement, press X (mouse and pad legs), assert zero commands and an intact selection; repeat with an in-progress drag.

title: Node_Select mirror terminal-clear leg unpinned — a mirror that selects terminals passes the suite
evidence: harness/parity.odin:769 `evs(inp.Pad_Button_Press{button = .Dpad_Down}), // cursor -> node 0 (terminal: mirror clears)`; parity.odin:982 `if r, ok := find(runs, devs, .Pad); ok && r.sel_node != 1 {` (the only new pad sel_node assert); parity.odin:84 `sel_node: i64,` with the struct doc 'the final input-surface state as SCALARS'; app/input/exec.odin:193-199 `if inp.pad_has {` `slot, ok := pp.node_slot(inp.topo, inp.pad_node)` `if ok && slot < u32(len(inp.topo.node_kind)) && inp.topo.node_kind[slot] == .Junction {` `inp.sel_node = i64(inp.pad_node)` `inp.sel_pipe = -1` `} else {` `inp.sel_node = -1` `inp.sel_pipe = -1` `}`.
detail: Parity_Run captures only final scalars; the pad script parks on terminal node 0 before the junction, so a mirror that selects terminals passes every assertion (final sel_node still 1). The .Junction branch is removable without failing the suite.
recommended_fix: Add a check_states case (or new scenario) whose pad script ends parked on a terminal and asserts sel_node == -1; the render gate alone backstops the affordance.

title: poll.odin RIGHT_FACE_LEFT -> .X raylib adapter is never exercised by any test
evidence: app/input/poll.odin:27 `case .RIGHT_FACE_LEFT: return .X, true // Xbox X / PS Square — the 5.5 demolish confirm (the keyboard X twin)`; harness/parity.odin:18-21 'NO physical device: the mappings run on the event data alone (the poll adapters in input/poll.odin are the only raylib-state readers, and the parity test never calls them).'
detail: The new physical mapping is never exercised: parity scripts Pad_Button_Press directly and never calls poll.odin (documented by design). A swapped button constant (e.g. .RIGHT_FACE_UP) ships the demolish confirm untested on real pads.
recommended_fix: Add a tiny @(test) unit for pad_map asserting RIGHT_FACE_LEFT->.X (and the existing buttons), or record the adapter blind spot explicitly in the harness header.
